title: Long-Tenancy Cleaning Courtesy on the Security Deposit Account
content:
**Term.** A long tenancy earns a cleaning courtesy on the Security Deposit Account. The courtesy is a share of the whole-unit cleaning charge, as reckoned on the surfaces left in place, that is not charged.

- **Full courtesy.** 0.20 (20 percent) for a tenancy of at least 48 full months from the lease's move-in date to its move-out date, with no returned payment dated on the lease fewer than twelve full months before the handling date.
- **Partial courtesy.** 0.10 (10 percent) for a tenancy of at least 48 full months with exactly one returned payment dated in those twelve months.
- **No courtesy** for any other tenancy.

The courtesy is taken on that same whole-unit cleaning charge and is deducted from the corrected cleaning charge. The corrected cleaning charge is then rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Records read.** From the Apartment Home Lease: the move-in date and the returned payments posted on the lease ledger, with their dates. From the deposit account: the move-out date.

## Ladder

| Full months, move-in to move-out | Returned payments on the lease in the twelve full months before the handling date | Courtesy share |
|---|---|---|
| 48 or more | none | 0.20 |
| 48 or more | exactly one | 0.10 |
| 48 or more | two or more | none |
| 47 or fewer | any | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- A tenancy from 10 May 2021 to 10 May 2025 is 48 full months and meets the tenure. Ending on 9 May 2025, it is 47 full months and does not.
- One returned payment dated 13 months before the handling date falls outside the twelve months and does not count. One dated 11 months before it counts.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** The whole-unit cleaning charge is 195.00 USD and the courtesy is 0.20. The courtesy is 39.00 USD, leaving 156.00 USD of the whole-unit charge in the corrected cleaning charge.
